QEVA MIRROR PROCEDURE 0.1
=========================

1. Acquire an entire named release, not a hand-selected archive fragment.
2. Record acquisition time, transport, source, release ID, and manifest hashes.
3. Verify MANIFEST.sha256 and MANIFEST.sha512 with independent implementations.
4. Validate snapshot/QEVA-BAG payload and tag manifests.
5. Run scripts/verify.py in a clean environment when Python 3 is available.
6. Serve or store immutable release bytes; put local metadata outside the release tree.
7. Keep at least one copy in a different administrative and physical failure domain.
8. Quarterly: re-read every byte and compare both manifests.
9. Annually: restore into an empty directory, reconstruct object links, and publish the result.
10. Before a digest, medium, encoding, or format becomes unsafe, create a new witnessed
    representation while preserving the old bytes and documenting the transformation.

A mirror declaration should name its custodian, jurisdiction, contact role, storage class,
last full fixity audit, last recovery drill, supported release IDs, and planned successor.

Do not call two buckets in one cloud account independent mirrors.
Do not call an untested offline disk a recoverable copy.
Do not sign a manifest unless you independently obtained and checked the bytes.
